summary: VistaOne, L.P. filed an 8-K disclosing its Transactional NAV per Unit as of July 31, 2026, and details of a quarterly Unit repurchase program. On August 19, 2026, the Fund repurchased 894,618 Class A-B, A-I, I, and A-S Units at an average price of $31.58 per Unit, totaling $28.3 million, subject to a 5% early repurchase deduction. The repurchase program is routine, capped at 5% of NAV per quarter, and discretionary. This is an ordinary periodic disclosure of NAV and ongoing repurchase activity, not a special situation such as a tender offer or capital return event. What to watch: continued quarterly repurchase levels and any program modifications.
